_comment: Trait parity manifest — traits emitted by R3FCompiler that have NO registered BrowserRuntime handler.
_doc: A trait here is classified as a no-op in the native runtime: the compiler emits it (for schema / downstream targets) but BrowserRuntime does not apply it at runtime. CI gate: scripts/holo-ci/check-trait-parity.mjs. When a handler IS added to BrowserRuntime for one of these traits, REMOVE it from this list so the gate stays tight. When R3FCompiler emits a NEW trait, add a handler to BrowserRuntime OR add it here with a reason.
